chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Najran, from Asim ibn Humayd, from Muhammad ibn Qays, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said:

Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) judged regarding a slave who divorced his wife with two divorces, then copulated with her afterwards. So he ordered a man to whip both of them and separate what is between them; he flogged each one of them with fifty lashes.
ai.seo_question: What is the penalty for a slave who divorces his wife twice and then consummates the marriage?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi establishes the specific hadd penalty for a slave who consummates marriage after a revocable divorce (talaq raj'i), mandating fifty lashes for each party and their separation. It highlights the jurisprudential distinction in Shia fiqh where slaves receive half the corporal punishment of free men, reflecting the principle derived from the Quranic verse on slaves. The ruling underscores the legal status of the slave's wife and the immediate effect of the divorce on their marital bond.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Ibn Abu najran, from Aasim Bin Humeyd, from Muhammad Bin Qays, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> judged regarding an owned (slave) who divorced his wife with two divorces, then copulated with her afterwards. So he<sup>asws</sup> ordered a man to whip both of them, and separate what is between the two of them. He whipped each one of the two with fifty lashes’.
